utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’d be really helpful. I’ll let you know if I hear anything else about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll check in if I hear anything around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the repair drive and tell folks what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll do that and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening—what details do we have so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly second-hand, honestly—I’ve heard it’s for the roof and a few busted steps, but I’m still waiting on the full details. If you’ve got the latest, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the latest yet either, so I don’t want to guess. Let’s wait for the full details and then we can sort out what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supply list for the repair drive — just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late, but I still need screws, duct tape, and a couple paint brushes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll note screws, duct tape, and a couple paint brushes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help pull folks together for the repair drive—just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Jules — can you confirm you’ll handle the sign-up list and spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll handle the sign-up list and spread the word. Just send me any details you want included.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s coming along nicely — people have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning. If you need anything fixed, this is the time to ask!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’s great to hear. What kinds of tools or parts are still needed most?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly basic hand tools, screws, duct tape, and any extra wiring folks have lying around. If anyone’s got a working drill or a good ladder to spare, those would be a big help too!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m in, I just need to remember what day I promised to help. Did you want me to bring tools or just show up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just show up is fine, but if you’ve got a screwdriver and a flashlight, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — I’ll bring a screwdriver and a flashlight, and I’ll try not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive spots, so I can point us to the right place when we’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start spreading the word right away and send folks your way when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll keep the spot info handy and direct everyone there when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — we still need a few volunteers for the signup table, some tools sorted, and the list of homes that need visits checked one more time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the signup table and help sort the tools. If you have the home list, I’ll check it over too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to check the flyer, but I got pulled away; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I saw the repair drive moved to the community center parking lot, and they’re taking donations from 9 to 12 now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — community center parking lot, 9 to 12. Thanks for catching me up; I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got the boxes lined up and I’m ready to head over when you are.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, I’m ready too — let’s head over and get started.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m ready to help, Faye—just tell me what needs fixing and when we’re going. I like to keep things simple and on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — that helps a lot. I’ll check the school schedule and send you the repair drive time as soon as I’ve got it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. Just let me know the time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. When is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s this Saturday morning at the community hall, and we’ll be taking in tool donations and fixing up a few items on site.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at the community hall works for me — I can help around pickup and school schedules. What time should I tell folks to bring the tool donations?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’ll need the pickup time and where we’re dropping everything off first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — I’ll send the pickup time and drop-off spot, then we can figure out the rest.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once I have those details, I can plan around the route and make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on today. I’ll be there with the tools around noon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what time are we meeting for the repair drive, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’m sorry, I don’t have the time in front of me. Can you remind me, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t know it either — that’s why I was asking you. Could you check and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m so glad the repair drive is happening — folks around here really do show up for one another. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along any updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, thank you, Tess. I appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Uli — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything useful. I’m rooting for a big turnout!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the first thing you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s start with the front gate latch—it’s been sticking for a while. If you can take a look at that, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can handle that. I’ll check the front gate latch first and see what’s causing it to stick.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Mara — I think we still need to sort the sign-up list and figure out who’s bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the sign-up list and get it organized. If you want, I can also ask around about tools tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m putting together the repair drive and wanted to invite you—if you’re free, we’d love the extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for asking, Quinn. I’m free for a bit and can help out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear—thank you! Swing by the community room when you can, and I’ll get you set up with a job right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we still need for the repair drive and make a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Cleo—thank you. If you send me the list, I’ll make sure we get the word out right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll put the list together and send it over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can put something in, though I’m keeping things a bit tight right now. Thanks for organizing it, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli — even a little helps. Do you want me to note you down for now?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please note me down for a small amount. I appreciate it, Mina.
